integrity: All-degree statements follow from an exact nine-state transfer identity and marginal transfer; finite independent full-polynomial enumeration checks degrees through 14. No externally independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The probability measure weights each monic denominator by its orthogonal multiplicity. The result treats only the two linear irreducibles over the binary field; it neither proves the proposed positive-multiplicity density nor controls nonlinear prime factors. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent review, including full comparison with Lauder (1999).
title: Exact joint linear-prime law for binary continuant denominators
